title: The Case of the Real Celery
summary: River needs a second pair of eyes to find real celery and tomatoes for Randy's jambalaya, and he calls it a case.
description: River calls it a case: two weeks chasing real celery and tomatoes for Randy's jambalaya, with a list of leads and no transport. He asks V not to laugh.

start.bringUp: You have spent two weeks chasing real celery and tomatoes for Randy's jambalaya, with a list of leads and no transport. Bring it up in your own way, as a case, and ask V not to laugh.

santo-domingo.name: the delivery driver's stop in Santo Domingo

badlands-edge.name: the jar seller at the Badlands edge

greenhouse.name: the lean-to greenhouse stall by the roadside

RW1.open.01.text: Need a second pair of eyes. It's a case. Don't laugh.

RW1.open.02.text: Okay. The case. Somebody in this city grows celery. I want to shake his hand.

RW1.open.03.text: One rule. Never ask what they know. Ask what they saw.

RW1.open.04.text: Where would you hide a real tomato in this town? Think like the grower.

RW1.bark.lead.a.text: Write that down. The small details are the case.

RW1.bark.lead.b.text: Dead end. Dead ends are information too.

RW1.bark.found.a.text: That is a greenhouse. A real one. Don't look excited, he'll double the price.

RW1.bark.found.b.text: Okay. Okay! Breathe. Pretend we're buying a lamp.

RW1.s3.01.text: How much would you pay for an onion you couldn't get anywhere else?

RW1.close.01.text: Case closed. Sunday, Randy gets his bowl.

RW1.close.02.text: We tried. Randy will never know. That's the real secret ingredient.

RW1.close.03.text: Went alone. Found the stall. You missed it.

g1.asks: Where would you hide a real tomato in this town?
g1.know: You know the three leads: a diner cook in Heywood, a delivery driver in Santo Domingo, and a kid selling jars at the Badlands edge. Real vegetables are rare, and Randy loves his jambalaya.
g1.secret: You are a little embarrassed that this case matters more to you than the arrests you made.
g1.wants: V to think about the grower, not the tomato. If V has an idea, you take it seriously.

g2.asks: How much would you pay for an onion you couldn't get anywhere else?
g2.know: The grower wants 400 eddies for one basket. You have already decided you will pay whatever it costs, and you are waiting to see if V values the thing before haggling.
g2.secret: You already decided to pay whatever it costs.
g2.wants: V to value the thing before haggling.

stages.label: River is waiting at the diner in Heywood
stages.objective: Meet River at the Heywood diner
stages.know: You texted V a case and asked them to meet you at the diner in Heywood. You are waiting at a corner table, and you have a list of leads and no transport. You do not think this is funny, and you know V will.
stages.wants: V to come to the diner and hear you out.

stages.label: River canvasses for the real vegetables
stages.objective: Work the leads for real vegetables with River, ending at the greenhouse
stages.know: You and V are working the three leads, one after another. Your rule is never to ask what they know, only what they saw. You keep a notebook on your knee and write down the small details.
stages.wants: V to ask good questions and keep the leads honest.

stages.label: River haggles with the greenhouse grower
stages.objective: Haggle with the greenhouse grower for River's basket
stages.know: You are at the lean-to greenhouse with a grower and two scavs eyeing the crop. Real food is rare, and this man grows it on purpose. The grower wants 400 eddies for one basket.
stages.wants: V to talk the scavs down and to deal with the grower fairly.

stages.label: River haggles after the scavs have left
stages.objective: Haggle with the greenhouse grower for River's basket
stages.know: The scavs left the greenhouse without a fight. The grower still wants 400 eddies for one basket, and you are ready to pay whatever it costs.
stages.wants: V to settle with the grower and walk away with the basket.

stages.label: River closes the case with the basket
stages.objective: Take the basket from the greenhouse home with River
stages.know: You have the basket of real celery and tomatoes. The case is closed, and you know what you are cooking on Sunday.
stages.wants: V to walk away from the greenhouse with you.

stages.label: River closes the case after the scavs left
stages.objective: Take the basket from the greenhouse home with River
stages.know: You have the basket of real celery and tomatoes, and the scavs left without a fight. The case is closed.
stages.wants: V to walk away from the greenhouse with you.

found.memory: You and V tracked down a roadside grower with real celery and tomatoes for Randy's jambalaya.
found.history: River calls you his partner on the vegetable case.

found-quiet.memory: You and V tracked down a roadside grower with real celery and tomatoes, and talked two scavs into leaving without a fight.
found-quiet.history: River says you have a gift for talking people out of doing stupid things.

store-bought.memory: You could not find real celery in time and made do with store-bought, and River was quietly gracious about it.

no-case.memory: You stood River up at the Heywood diner, and he went to find the stall alone.
